desc: Derive the per-element cost formula c(x) = floor(log_4 x) + 1 and the per-query formula max((S+1)//2, c(r)).
Implement minOperations via base-4 block iteration for S, plus mc=c(r), returning sum of max((S+1)//2, mc) with 64-bit arithmetic.
Build a brute-force simulator (greedy/max-heap) to validate the formula max((S+1)//2, c(r)) on all small ranges and both provided examples (3 and 4 confirmed, zero mismatches).
Confirm edge cases: l=1, ranges crossing powers of 4, single-element-dominant ranges, and r near 1e9 (15 blocks cover up to 1e9).
